milestone.title: Security trust boundaries and install/display hardening

intent.outcome: Repository-controlled verification cannot run before explicit trust; Raul never emits raw terminal controls from plan text; generated env.sh quotes arbitrary paths; uninstall deletes only within an opened canonical harness root.

problem.description: ac_verify defaults to sh -c for plan verification without a trust gate. Raul renders untrusted strings without sanitizing ESC/OSC. install env.sh interpolates MP_INSTALL_DIR unsafely. Uninstall accepts absolute paths whose basename matches the skill id.

in_scope: Persist trust by canonical repo identity after confirmation; noninteractive fails closed
No verify execution including argv-only before trust
Display-boundary sanitizer for plan/subprocess strings in Raul
Uninstall via opened harness-root handle with no-follow semantics
out_of_scope: Persistence transactions and schema fail-closed (Groups A/B provide prerequisites)

design_decisions.choice: Treat verification execution as an explicit capability: persist trust by canonical repository identity after confirmation; noninteractive fails closed unless trust exists; no repository-controlled verification (including argv-only) runs before trust; argv-only allowlist is post-trust shell-minimization; arbitrary shell is explicit post-trust opt-in showing the exact command; preserve timeout/process-group/bounded-output; document that trusted shell is intentional execution not a sandbox.
design_decisions.rationale: ac_verify defaults to sh -c for plan verification without a trust gate (Finding 19).

design_decisions.choice: Add one display-boundary sanitizer for every untrusted plan/subprocess string in Raul; preserve newline/tab only where structurally intended; escape or visibly replace C0/C1, ESC, DEL, bidi overrides, and unsafe zero-width controls; keep Unicode width/truncation after sanitization.
design_decisions.rationale: Raul renders untrusted strings without sanitizing ESC/OSC, enabling terminal control injection (Finding 20).

design_decisions.choice: Encode installation paths with a correct POSIX single-quote routine (or avoid generated shell source); write env.sh atomically; returned path snippets use the same safe encoder.
design_decisions.rationale: Generated env.sh interpolates MP_INSTALL_DIR unsafely, enabling command injection via path characters (Finding 21).

design_decisions.choice: Store canonical harness root plus relative installed artifact path; reject symlink components; delete relative to an opened canonical harness-root directory handle with no-follow semantics; verify containment, target type, and artifact identity; refuse deletion when containment cannot be established.
design_decisions.rationale: Uninstall accepts absolute paths whose basename matches the skill id, escaping harness roots (Finding 22).

findings.description: Legacy installed-skill rows were backfilling installed_path only, leaving the new harness_root/artifact_path containment fields absent after upgrade; fixed by atomically backfilling all containment metadata when the configured root canonicalizes.
findings.summary: Backfill containment metadata for legacy rows

findings.description: Descriptor-relative recursive uninstall could encounter an ordinary permission failure after deleting some children; fixed by preflighting write/search permission across the anchored target tree before the first unlink and preserving the manifest on failure.

The completion gate found that preflight traversal advanced the directory offset shared by dup(), causing the removal walk to see EOF and unlinkat(AT_REMOVEDIR) to fail with ENOTEMPTY for legitimate skills. Fixed by rewinding each fdopendir stream before enumeration.
findings.summary: Reset duplicated directory stream offsets before traversal

findings.description: Finding 19 regression: reject_symlink_components walks every absolute prefix and fails closed on platform intermediary symlinks (macOS /var → /private/var, /tmp → /private/tmp). Any non-canonical project_root under /var/folders or /tmp therefore cannot establish or use repository trust via the CLI — mp milestone verify reports "trust is not inherited through symlinked path /var" before the trust prompt/store runs. The intended rule (symlink alias must not inherit trust for the same repo) is sound, but the implementation over-rejects prefix rewrites. ac_verify_trust.rs masks this by canonicalize()-ing the temp root before run_one_in (L15/L17). Reproducer: mktemp -d project under /var/folders, mp init + milestone with runnable verification, MP_VERIFY_TRUST_STORE pointing at a fresh path, mp milestone verify --project-root <tmpdir> (non-canon) → symlink error; same with $(realpath <tmpdir>) → normal "not trusted" fail-closed. Production /Users paths are unaffected. Fix direction: key trust on canonical identity while limiting the no-inheritance check to aliases of the repository root (or canonicalize in PlanContext without re-opening alias inheritance).
findings.summary: Trust gate rejects macOS system prefix symlinks
